_comment: Guards for the shared working directory. registries/ holds live batchtools registries with cluster jobs queued against them; an agent once rm -rf'd one mid-run. See .claude/CLAUDE.md. These rules match COMMAND TEXT and are therefore leaky by construction (cd registries && rm x, xargs rm, unlink() from an Rscript). They stop absent-minded phrasings, not determined ones. The boundary version is sandbox.filesystem.denyWrite with the sandbox enabled.
